summary_markdown:
A problem was identified on the AllUnite privacy page, specifically in the 'Our presence' section regarding geographical representation. The consensus was to update or fix the map displayed there.

Someone suggested updating the map using a PNG picture. It was agreed that fixing the existing map would be the best approach. [me] confirmed that Alexey (or someone capable) would look into this, and [p5] reiterated that the current website presence is more optimistic than what they possess.
decisions: The 'Our presence' map on the AllUnite privacy page needs updating/fixing.
action_items: Alexey (or someone) will look into fixing the map on the website.
